description: This file contains utility functions for URL manipulation, tracking, and local storage management within a web application, including functions for URL parsing, parameter handling, and tracking data collection.

methods.name: urlToId
methods.description: Converts a URL string into a URL-friendly ID by removing protocol, domain, query parameters, and replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens.

methods.name: storePathAsLastPath
methods.description: Stores the current page path in local storage as the last visited page, ignoring certain paths like login or signup.

methods.name: getLastPath
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored page path from local storage, defaults to 'home' if none found.

methods.name: getUrlUtmParams
methods.description: Extracts UTM parameters from the current URL's query string, returns them in lowercase if present.

methods.name: triggerUtmRegistration
methods.description: Triggers a registration event if UTM source is available, removing stored UTM parameters afterward.

methods.name: getStoredUtmParams
methods.description: Retrieves stored UTM parameters from local storage.

methods.name: getUrlParams
methods.description: Returns all URL query parameters as an object.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components: protocol, hostname, port, pathname, search, hash, host.

methods.name: deleteUrlParam
methods.description: Removes a specific query parameter from the current URL.

methods.name: setUrlParams
methods.description: Sets or updates multiple URL query parameters.

methods.name: getGclid
methods.description: Retrieves the GCLID parameter from URL or local storage.

methods.name: generateSessionId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique session ID stored in session storage.

methods.name: getPageTrackingData
methods.description: Collects and returns various data points for page tracking, including URL, referrer, user agent, screen size, and UTM parameters.
